tech.summary: Beijing-based Moonshot AI reduced the cyber-offensive capabilities of its newest model, Kimi K3.1 Pro, stripping cyber-related data from its training corpus and reinforcement-learning environments while keeping general coding skills. The 3-trillion-parameter-class open-weight model, whose weights go public by November 4, scored 81.0% on an internal cyber benchmark versus 90.5% for the unfiltered version. The company said it does not aim to release open weights that extend the frontier of cyber capability, as China proposed export controls on AI-driven malware-generation tools last week.
tech.title: Moonshot AI curbs hacking ability in new Kimi model as fears grow over AI-powered cyberattacks

tech.summary: Reuters reports that both the Biden and Trump administrations repeatedly asked SpaceX to switch Starlink on or off in various countries — cutting service to prevent Iranian proxy militias in Yemen and Lebanon from using it, and activating it inside Iran and Ukraine to support protesters and the military. The previously unreported requests come after Ukraine's military access to Starshield was throttled this month, raising questions about how much US foreign policy now runs through one private company.
tech.title: US has for years asked Musk to alter Starlink service in Ukraine, Middle East, sources say

tech.summary: Reuters Breakingviews warns the AI data-centre boom is hitting real-world walls: grid-connection delays pushed Microsoft to walk away from a UK lease with neocloud Nscale, local opposition shelved NextDC's Melbourne project, and multiple US states have imposed moratoria on new data-centre construction. With borrowing costs squeezing neocloud margins, a world of fewer, pricier data centres would force chipmakers, AI users and financiers to recalibrate — though Musk says SpaceX alone will have 13 gigawatts of computing power by end-2027.
tech.title: The Week in Breakingviews: Data dreams delayed

tech.summary: Gartner predicts more than 80% of neocloud providers will cease independent operations by 2030, warning that over $3.5 trillion of AI infrastructure spending could face impairment. AI providers are expected to spend nearly $1 trillion on AI infrastructure in 2026 and another $6 trillion by 2030, but enterprise and consumer AI revenue attributable to data centres will reach at most $3.6 trillion — leaving a $4.9 trillion shortfall against the $8.5 trillion needed to cover spending and financing costs at a 12% return.
tech.title: Gartner: 80% of neoclouds to lose independence by 2030 as AI infrastructure spending outpaces revenue

tech.summary: This week's gadget launches include HP's ZBook Ultra G3a 16-inch mobile workstation with AMD Ryzen AI Max+ and up to 300B-parameter local LLM support, Casio's new G-SHOCK 2500 series, the Oura Ring 5 smart ring, Lenovo's Yoga Pro 9n and Yoga 9n 2-in-1, and Sony's ECM-AX10 — billed as the world's first spatial audio microphone for smartphones. The roundup also notes Google Cloud customers now getting access to OpenAI's ChatGPT models.
tech.title: Gadgets Weekly: HP ZBook Ultra G3a, Oura Ring 5 & Lenovo Yoga Pro 9n launched

tech.summary: HCLTech launched an NVIDIA-powered software-defined vehicle validation offering on October 21, combining agentic AI, physical AI simulation and intelligent orchestration with five NVIDIA components including Omniverse, Cosmos, Alpamayo and Isaac Sim. The launch follows $3.3 billion in Q2 deal bookings, up 27% year over year, but LKP Research kept a Hold rating with a Rs 1,360 target, citing low-single-digit organic growth and weak discretionary tech spending.
tech.title: HCLTech launches NVIDIA-powered vehicle validation tool as analysts stay cautious

pakistan.summary: Pakistan face England in the fourth match of the home ODI tri-series at Lahore's Gaddafi Stadium today (Sunday, 1:00 PM PKT). Pakistan have won both their matches so far — by 37 runs against Sri Lanka and 87 runs against England — and a win today books their place in the October 31 final. England, who lost both matches including a 430-run chase collapse against Sri Lanka, must win to stay alive. Arafat Minhas, who took 6 wickets in the first meeting, is the man to watch.
pakistan.title: Pakistan vs England today: final berth in sight as Lahore leg begins

pakistan.summary: Pakistan's FIFA U-15 World Cup debut in Azerbaijan began with a dream and ended in a nightmare on Saturday, as the Shaheens squandered a 2-0 lead and fell 4-2 to Gambia. Ameer Hamza scored the tournament's opening goal in the fifth minute and Baxi Hamal Khan doubled the lead, but Gambia pulled one back before half-time and completed the turnaround with three second-half goals.
pakistan.title: Pakistan squander two-goal lead in FIFA U-15 World Cup debut loss

pakistan.summary: Pakistan reopened its Gabd-Rimdan border crossing with Iran on Saturday, restoring bilateral trade and letting stranded trucks carrying LPG and essential food commodities move after a weeklong suspension that began on October 17. Officials cleared consignments with notes dated October 16 or earlier at Gate 250 in Gwadar. Traders expect the restored supply chain to ease a nationwide LPG shortage and soaring energy and food prices.
pakistan.title: Gabd border crossing with Iran reopened

pakistan.summary: Power supply to several areas of Sindh and Punjab was disrupted from the Uch Power Plant after unidentified men blew up a 220kV transmission pylon near Dera Murad Jamali in Nasirabad district early Saturday. Cities including Shikarpur, Rahim Yar Khan, Sadiqabad, Sukkur, Larkana, Jacobabad, Kashmore and Guddu were affected. No group has claimed responsibility, and repairs await security clearance.
pakistan.title: Nasirabad pylon blast cuts power to many areas

pakistan.summary: Wapda signed a Rs133.18 billion hydro-mechanical (HM-1) contract with the Power China-IKAN Joint Venture for the Diamer-Bhasha Dam on Saturday at Wapda House, Lahore. The contract covers gates, steel structures, flushing tunnels, power intakes, dam outlets and related electrical works. The dam, on the Indus 40km downstream of Chilas, will store 8.1 million acre-feet of water and generate 4,500 megawatts on completion.
pakistan.title: Wapda inks Rs133bn deal for dam project

pakistan.summary: Pakistan and Canada concluded the third round of negotiations on a Bilateral Investment Treaty on Saturday, with the Board of Investment saying both sides made significant progress. Talks covered direct and indirect investments, portfolio investments, performance requirements, expropriation, third-party funding and investor-state dispute settlement. The treaty is expected to boost investor confidence and expand business opportunities between the two countries.
pakistan.title: Talks on investment treaty with Canada make progress
